what: Generate analytical alternatives via LLM — gen_alternatives
title: Generate analytical alternatives via LLM — gen_alternatives
text: `gen_alternatives()` takes existing `schema` `multiverse` asks Large Language Model suggest methodologically valid, alternative approaches specific step (block) analysis pipeline. `prompt_alternatives()` helper function constructs exact instruction set sent LLM.

title: Generate analytical alternatives via LLM — gen_alternatives
code: gen_alternatives(x, block, n = 3, provider = "gemini", file_path = NULL, ...)  # S3 method for class 'schema' gen_alternatives(x, block, n = 3, provider = "gemini", file_path = NULL, ...)  # S3 method for class 'multiverse' gen_alternatives(x, block, ...)  prompt_alternatives(block, n = 3, print = FALSE)

title: Generate analytical alternatives via LLM — gen_alternatives
text: x `schema` `multiverse` object, character string specifying file path valid `tines` YAML file. block character string. exact `tag` step/node want LLM generate alternatives . n integer. number distinct alternatives want LLM generate. Defaults `3`. provider character string specifying LLM provider. Currently defaults `"gemini"`. (`gemini-3-flash-preview` via `ellmer`). file_path character string specifying save generated YAML output. `NULL` (default), `capture.output()` return result character vector. ... Additional arguments passed methods `ellmer::chat_google_gemini()`. print logical. `TRUE`, prompt generated `prompt_alternatives()` printed console readable format. Default `FALSE`

title: Generate analytical alternatives via LLM — gen_alternatives
text: * `gen_alternatives()` invisibly returns `NULL` writes output `file_path`. * `prompt_alternatives()` returns formatted character string containing LLM prompt.

title: Generate analytical alternatives via LLM — gen_alternatives
text: **Important:** function relies `ellmer` package communicate Google's Gemini API. must API credentials configured correctly R environment (e.g., via `GEMINI_API_KEY` environment variable) work.

title: Generate analytical alternatives via LLM — gen_alternatives
code: if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{ # Generate 3 alternatives for the "handle-missing-data" step gen_alternatives(   x = my_schema,   block = "handle-missing-data",   n = 3,   file_path = "alternatives.yaml" ) } # }
